newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market quiet - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market quiet - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, compared to Friday's close, USDA said. Trade was very slow. Demand and seller interest light. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
